name: Astroport
rootCause: Astroport (a Cosmos ecosystem DEX) announced a security incident on the Neutron chain that may have resulted in the theft of admin privileges for its contracts. Neutron has halted chain operations for investigation, and the project advised users to immediately withdraw liquidity from all Astroport pools across chains. Terra-side contracts were unaffected.
